tess: Quick sync: MercuryBank POC needs streaming SDK + function calls + strict JSON schema output for downstream ledger. Blockers: EU data residency, CMK, token rotation for browser streams, and predictable pricing for 100 QPS sustained.
omar: Are they asking on-prem or VPC?
tess: Prefer VPC first. CISO requested 12mo audit logs and contract termination purge clause.
vy: SDK note: we support websocket + SSE. For browser use short TTL tokens (5m) and refresh via backend exchange. Server SDK can use rotated long TTL.
infra-bot: Created ticket MER-552 in presales tracker.
omar: Pricing: 100 QPS * ~90 tokens = estimate. Recommend reserved dedicated or commit discount; will draft numbers.
vy: Structured tool call format: {"tool":"fetch_account","args":{}}. Server validates schema and rejects malformed calls.
legal-bot: Requested SOC2 and encryption docs. Also need confirmation of CMK availability in VPC/dedicated options.
tess: Action items: @vy sample apps (browser+node) showing token refresh and tool call; @omar pricing lanes; @legal-bot collect docs. Sync scheduled 15:30 CET.
omar: I'll add fallback policy (route to quantized model) and note regression risk.
vy: Will include batching and prefix caching tips to lower token spend in the deck.
tess: Thanks all. Short thread 44d
